field_levers.lever: Optimizer state precision: fp32 moments (current) → int8 quantization
field_levers.why_applicable_at_consumer_scale: File-backed offset already removes pagefile pressure (commit-zero cost). Quantization saves host storage (16.6 GiB → 4.15 GiB at 4×compression) and disk I/O (smaller memmap files, faster access). Muon's single momentum buffer is a prime target (4B/param → 1B/param saves 6.6 GiB for 140 Muon params).
field_levers.cost_class: SAVES storage + I/O; COSTS gradient scale range (int8 requires dynamic range management, per-layer quant explored in parameter-golf but not here)

field_levers.cost_class: SAVES metadata (filesystem inodes) + I/O seek time; COSTS code complexity for indexing
